ev.q: From 2001–2002 to 2009–2010, the rate of emergency department visits for alcohol-related diagnoses for males increased 38%, from 68 to 94 visits per 10,000 population.
Rate per 10,000 population, based on 2-year annual average.
From 2001–2002 to 2009–2010, the rate of emergency department visits for alcohol-related diagnoses for males increased 38%, from 68 to 94 visits per 10,000 population.
Throughout the period, the visit rate for males was higher than the visit rate for females.
Source: CDC. National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey.
